summary: The self-containment rewrite worked. Every defect that terminated the previous cycle is discharged in these bytes, and two repairs exceed what was asked: the re-measurement clause returns with the property-pin scoping I recommended, and D-030's frame is now genuinely open with the platform and first-install-trust surfaces added by name. All seven entries carry their own operative clauses; no entry strands another on revert; the D-000 over-extension is negated in all five Route B entries and again in the closing list; the four-versus-seven arithmetic checks out in all four entries that assert it. One systematic defect blocks consent, and it is a regression introduced by the same rewrite that fixed everything else: making the entries terse and self-contained stripped the documentation elements D-000 clause 3 requires. Measured across the three drafts, 'alternatives' occurrences fall 7 to 3 to 0, 'readiness effect' 5 to 2 to 0, and 'reversibility' 5 to 0 to 0. All seven entries would be adopted non-compliant with the protocol they are adopted under, and the alternatives that were deleted still exist in the CONTESTED drafts, so the fix is recovery rather than authorship. This is turn 1 of 3; the finding set is narrow and mechanical and I expect convergence.

objections.claim: All seven entries omit documentation elements D-000 clause 3 requires of every decision recorded under the protocol. Alternatives are absent from all seven, reversibility class from all seven, and the readiness-effect statement that every prior draft carried per entry from all seven. This is a regression created by the self-containment rewrite, not an inherited defect.
objections.evidence: D-000 clause 3, measured at COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md: 'Every such decision is documented in this register — decision, ALTERNATIVES, rationale, reviewer verdict with digest, REVERSIBILITY CLASS, overturn procedure.' Measured occurrence counts, case-insensitive, across the three drafts in this lineage: turn-2 draft (744ad8e3) 'alternative' 7, 'readiness effect' 5, 'reversibility' 5; turn-3 draft (4cffad69) 'alternative' 3, 'readiness effect' 2, 'reversibility' 0; this draft (cd9f8f86) 'alternative' 0, 'readiness effect' 0, 'reversibility' 0. Every entry here has exactly two sections — Decision and Overturn — except D-031, which adds File 11 accounting. The Overturn sections state a procedure ('C-D026 only. Revert returns DR-002 to D-001's default') but never a class; the turn-2 draft stated 'Total.' explicitly for each. The loss is material for preference-laden decisions in particular: six of these seven are PREFERENCE-LADEN, and D-000 clause 5 makes their overturn cost the governing constraint, which cannot be assessed without a recorded reversibility class. It is material for auditability generally: the alternatives are what let a future reader see that D-028's Route A option was considered and rejected rather than never weighed. Those alternatives were not disproven — they exist in the CONTESTED drafts (turn-3 D-019 'Leave DR-002 on Route A until AC-1..AC-4 close. Named as reachable.'; turn-3 D-023 'Leave DR-003 on full Route A. Named as reachable.'; turn-2 D-017's five, D-019's four) and were deleted in the rewrite.
objections.proposedFix: Restore, per entry, an Alternatives section (recoverable verbatim from the CONTESTED drafts, which remain on disk at 744ad8e3 and 4cffad69), an explicit reversibility class alongside the existing overturn procedure, and the one-line readiness effect. For the six PREFERENCE-LADEN entries, restore the 'Honesty about the trade' paragraph as well, since D-000 clause 5 conditions their overturn procedure on the decision's cost.

objections.claim: D-025 §3 closes Route C to 'exactly one of these three forms'. That closed enumeration is not in D-001 §3, and D-025 is labelled RULE-GOVERNED — the same defect class that opened the terminated cycle, recurring one level down. The same draft opens D-030's frame for precisely this reason.
objections.evidence: D-025 §3: 'Route C — a product decision through the product-disposition process, recorded in EXACTLY ONE OF THESE THREE FORMS: (i) ... (ii) ... (iii) ...'. D-001 §3, measured at COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, reads only: '(C) a product decision through the product-disposition process.' It enumerates no recording forms and closes nothing. D-025's decision type is RULE-GOVERNED, which in the terminated cycle's turn-1 C2-D017-01 was found not to hold where the entry invented a closed set the cited sources did not contain; the repair then was to restate D-001's routes, and at turn 3 to make Route C a disjunction. A disjunction has now become a closed three-form rule with no successor clause and no count-pin consequence. I searched for a fourth lawful form and found none, so this is not currently a narrowing — but the entry forbids one prospectively, by a rule D-001 does not state. The inconsistency is internal: this same draft replaced D-030's closed five-category frame with 'including but not limited to' in response to the identical concern.
objections.proposedFix: Change 'recorded in exactly one of these three forms' to 'recorded in one of these forms, of which the following are the forms this corpus has used', and add the successor sentence the terminated cycle's entries carried: changing the enumeration requires a successor or supersession of this entry.

objections.claim: File 08 names the V1 coordinator as co-owner of DR-002 exactly as it does for DR-003, but D-030 states the joint-recording consequence and D-026 does not, so the same fact is treated two ways without explanation.
objections.evidence: File 08's owner cells: DR-002 is 'Evidence authority + V1 coordinator'; DR-003 is 'Threat-model authority + V1 coordinator'. D-030 §5 draws the consequence: 'The coordinator is a named co-owner of DR-003 and may record jointly with Threat-model authority; it does not replace that authority.' D-026 §4 says only 'The coordinator does not, under D-000, become the recording authority in place of Evidence authority' — correct, but silent on the co-ownership that file 08 records for this row too. The omission is conservative, since D-026 claims less authority than the owner cell would support, so nothing unlawful follows from it. But a reader cannot tell whether the silence is deliberate scoping or an oversight, and the two entries are the only places in the draft where this fact arises.
objections.proposedFix: Either add the D-030 §5 sentence to D-026 with 'Evidence authority' substituted, or state explicitly that D-026 declines to rely on the co-ownership and why.

objections.claim: D-030 is the only Route B selection entry lacking the seven-row accounting paragraph that D-026 through D-029 each carry — the paragraph added specifically to answer the four-versus-seven finding.
objections.evidence: D-026 §2, D-027 §2, D-028 §2 and D-029 §2 each recite that D-002's deferral of DR-106/109/113 rests on 'applied DR-002..008 successors', that 'Those successors are seven rows', and that the entry selects one and names the six it does not. The cycle-wide accounting still reconciles — DR-002/003/004/005/008-integration selected, DR-006/007 not — but it reconciles only by reading all five entries together, and each of the other four was written so it would not have to be.
objections.proposedFix: Add the same paragraph to D-030, naming DR-003 as the one selected and the six it does not select.

objections.claim: Lane P's count-pin lost the successor clause the predecessor entry carried, and the closing list dropped the clarifier that kept it honest about scheduled drafting.
objections.evidence: Two limbs. First: D-031 reads '(count-pinned at five steps)'. The CONTESTED D-024 read '(count-pinned at five steps; changing the enumeration requires a successor or supersession of this entry)'. The pin now states a count with no stated consequence for changing it, which is the form the terminated cycle's C2-D017-03 objected to in a different guise. Second: the closing list here reads 'Do not decide parallel-product posture or DR-117'; the CONTESTED D-024 draft read 'Do not decide parallel-product posture or DR-117 (they are authorized to be drafted, not decided).' The parenthetical is gone while D-031's accounting still authorizes drafting item 3 (DR-117 / default install) and item 1's remainder (parallel-product posture), so the closing list now reads as though those surfaces are untouched when the entry schedules their drafting. Both statements remain literally true; both were more informative one draft ago.
objections.proposedFix: Restore the successor clause on the count-pin and the parenthetical on the closing-list item.

objections.evidence: D-025 §4 closes: 'D-031, if adopted, uses this sentence.' D-025 and D-031 are severable per the draft header. The 'if adopted' hedge is present and the statement is therefore not false, and no operative text is at risk — D-031 restates both halves of the rule inline rather than relying on the citation, so self-containment holds in both directions. The residual is only that a RULE-GOVERNED entry makes a claim about a preference-laden sibling's content, which the terminated cycle removed from D-017 for the same reason.
objections.proposedFix: Drop the sentence. D-025 §4 states the rule completely without it, and D-031 already carries its own copy.

Axis 2, D-000 scope: PASSES. All five Route B entries individually negate the extension, each naming its own authority; D-030 handles the one genuine co-ownership case correctly against file 08's DR-003 owner cell; the closing list adds an explicit prohibition. No sentence in the draft extends D-000 to a surface authority file 08 does not name as coordinator-owned.

Axis 3, Route C: all three recording forms are present and each has corpus precedent — form (i) the product-disposition packet (CD-RT-5, pinned in file 08's DR-008 row); form (ii) user-made and recorded in the coordinator register (D-000 itself, 'made directly by the user in conversation'; and the register's status line 'ADOPTED (consensus reached or user-made)'); form (iii) coordinator under D-000 (D-002, D-018). I searched for a fourth lawful form and found none. The closure of the enumeration, not its completeness, is what I raise at C2N1-D025-01.

Axis 5, dual-track: PASSES and generalised beyond the instance I named at turn 3. D-026 §3, D-027 §3, D-028 §3 and D-029 §3 each state the specific authoritative obligation that remains owed, and each is explicitly adoption-independent.

Axis 6, scheduling versus live work: D-025 §4 and D-031's accounting agree, and D-031 restates the rule inline rather than depending on the citation. D-031's classification of D-018 as live product naming is consistent: D-018 is adopted and travelled route C.

Axis 7, D-030 scope frame: open. 'including but not limited to', with platform and trust added to the category list and the four-platform matrix and first-install trust added to the surfaces list. The falsifier sentence about omitting analyze's data plane is retained.

Axis 8, silent D-001 or D-002 amendment: none found. D-025 §5 states D-001 is not amended and no entry quotes the five conditions. D-031 restates SF-3 correctly including 'rows added by later recorded acts'. The D-002 deferral reason is quoted accurately in four entries. convergenceNote: This is turn 1 of 3, so nothing parks here. The single MUST-FIX is systematic but mechanical: it asks for restoration of D-000 clause 3 elements that exist verbatim in the CONTESTED drafts still on disk, not for new authorship or any change to an operative clause. No finding in this verdict contests a decision the draft makes — not the Route B selections, not the preview scoping, not the two-lane order, not the recording rules.
